title: Implement a checkpointed workflow state machine
prompt: Return a SQLite-backed workflow-state store. Dependencies map node to prerequisite IDs; require an acyclic graph. claim() transactionally claims one ready pending node; finish(node,success) persists terminal state; recover() explicitly resets interrupted running nodes to pending. Schema/dependency configuration must match on reopen. This core assumes recovery is called only when old workers are stopped; effects are a separate exercise.
